avoid: Tripping during the fast criss-cross variation
children.counts: Standard 32-beat loop counted aloud as 1-8 for each section.
children.game_version: Play 'Statue Nutbush' where kids do the grid steps but must freeze instantly if the music pauses during the turn-and-clap step.

seniors.seated_version: Perform side taps and back heel-touches while seated in a chair; perform seated knee lifts across the midline and finish with a clap without turning.
seniors.standing_version: Hold onto a chair back for stability during side taps, back touches, and gentle knee lifts; step-turn 90 degrees gently without jumping.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Maintain full song tempo or use a slowed practice track; reduce knee lift height to comfortable range.

feedback_rules.description: Dancers turning counter-clockwise during beat 29-32 should be corrected to turn 1/4 clockwise.

learning_units.description: Side touches step: weight on left leg, touch right foot to ground right and return twice; repeat with weight on right leg touching left foot twice (8 beats).
Back touches step: weight on left leg, move right foot back half a pace, touch and return twice; repeat with left foot twice (8 beats).
Knee raises across body: right knee brought across to left hip height twice, left knee to right hip height twice (8 beats).
Cross kicks: single kick of right leg across body, followed by left leg across body (4 beats).
Turn-and-clap: turn 1/4 clockwise, pause, then clap (4 beats).

prerequisites.description: Ability to maintain balance on one leg during side/back taps, knee raises, and kicks.

social_formats.description: Performed as a group line dance in a grid or box configuration at social functions, schools, weddings, and festivals.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Hands placed akimbo on hips during footwork, releasing to clap on count 32 (or count 4 of final sequence).
movement_profile.footwork: Side touches right and left (8 counts), back touches right and left (8 counts), knee raises (8 counts), cross kicks (4 counts), quarter turn and clap (4 counts).
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Box or grid formation, dancers facing the same wall and turning 90 degrees clockwise at the end of each 32-beat cycle.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Torso remains upright; hips twist slightly to accommodate cross-body knee raises and kicks.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Primarily grounded stepping; optional small jumps during the criss-cross variation.
movement_profile.partnering: None; performed as an individual within a group grid.
movement_profile.posture: Upright stance, feet shoulder-width apart in neutral position, hands akimbo on hips.

signature_moves.description: A 90-degree clockwise turn on the spot followed by a single sharp handclap.
signature_moves.name: Turn-and-clap

signature_moves.description: Jumping feet out, crossing legs in air/landing, jumping out, and clapping on the final 4 beats.
signature_moves.name: Criss-cross variation

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Turning counter-clockwise instead of clockwise; losing count during knee raises.

music_profile.sound_description: A high-energy 1970s funk-rock track characterized by an extended electric guitar and horn intro, driving drums on a constant 4/4 pulse, and gritty soulful vocals.

basic_steps: Touch right foot to the side and return twice, then touch left foot to the side and return twice (8 beats)
Touch right foot half a pace back and return twice, then touch left foot back and return twice (8 beats)
Raise right knee across body to left hip twice, then raise left knee across body to right hip twice (8 beats)
Kick right leg across body once, then kick left leg across body once (4 beats)
Turn 1/4 clockwise, pause, and clap hands (4 beats)
teaching.rhythm: 4/4 meter, stepped on every drum beat
